name: Aureon Global — 7-email Hormozi-rigorous sequence (named mechanism, no nag, forced-answer)
target: Real estate agents in DACH + NL closing 3+ deals/month OR brokerage teams of 2+ agents.
voice_notes: Hormozi rigour applied. Named mechanism (The Aureon Listing Pipeline) appears 3 times. Each follow-up takes a different angle (story-objection, new case study, refund math, forced yes/no, pure value drop, sharp breakup). Subjects are human, lowercase where natural, specific numbers > vague claims. Step 1 has no CTA button (handled by template via step_n=1). Length tapers: 90 -> 50 -> 60 -> 70 -> 40 -> 55 -> 60 words. NO apostrophes, NO em-dashes, NO word-internal hyphens. NO single quotes ('). Reply-stop wired via imap-poll. Required: {first_name}, {company}, {city}.
schedule_doc: delay_days = gap from PREVIOUS step's send. 0,3,4,5,6,8,9 = cumulative day 0,3,7,12,18,26,35.

variants.subject: {first_name} a yes or a no
variants.body:
Hi {first_name}.

If we could put 5 to 10 verified seller meetings on your calendar in {city} next month with zero ad spend from {company}, would you say yes?

A clear yes or a clear no both work.

Anna
